sloka: एवम् उक्ता च तेन आशु सखी जन समावृता ।गृहीता बलवत् कुब्जा सा तत् गृहम् अनादयत् ॥२-७८-१२॥
transliteration: evam uktā ca tena āśu sakhī jana samāvṛtā ।gṛhītā balavat kubjā sā tat gṛham anādayat ॥2-78-12॥

translations.english: Saying thus, he forcibly caught hold of the hunchback amidst her companions when she filled the house with her cries.
